claim: The 1993-01 through 2024-12 monthly momentum-factor mean is positive under the stated descriptive and weak-dependence scope.
estimand: Arithmetic population mean of the published monthly Mom factor over the fixed 384-month window, interpreted under weak stationarity.
exclusion_rules: Exclude provider missing-value sentinels at or below -99%; fail rather than silently continue if any fixed-window month is missing.
primary_method: Newey-West standard error of the sample mean with Bartlett weights and six lags; two-sided normal 95% interval.
sensitivity_set: Circular 12-month block bootstrap with 10,000 replications and seed 20260830; pre/post-2009 split; symmetric 1% trimming; remove five best and worst months; leave-one-year-out means.
decision_rule: Support requires a positive point estimate, positive lower bounds for both dependence-aware intervals, positive trimmed mean, and every leave-one-year-out mean positive; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE unless a valid refutation is established.
multiplicity_family: One preregistered headline mean claim; sensitivity analyses are robustness checks and are not separate confirmatory discoveries.
